UnitStatement: The Desktop Physics Workflow Smoke check covers the TP-MAC-02 desktop path over invented local preview data.
The smoke check is intentionally limited to workflow wiring and product-boundary signals.
The smoke check is not a validation, certification, compliance, or professional approval check.
Start the desktop app with: npm run dev --workspace apps/desktop.
Open the Vite URL printed by the command, normally http://127.0.0.1:5173/.
Initial load shows data-testid="desktop-preview-shell" and the header "OpenPipeStress Technical Preview".
The solve-panel shows initial status values from the fixture, including status-mechanics with "ready for preview diagnostics".
Clicking run-mechanics-preview triggers the mechanics preview run.
Results render in results-panel with grouped sections: result-group-displacement, result-group-reaction, result-group-force, result-group-moment, and result-group-stress.
Results include result rows result:force:pipe-P-120:axial and result:force:pipe-P-120:axial:end-j.

Clicking the axial force row opens result-detail-panel showing axial_force, element_local, end_i, recovered_from_local_element_stiffness, the sign convention, pipe:P-120, DEL-14-02, and run:preview-linear-static-001.
The endpoint-pair-table shows both result:force:pipe-P-120:axial and result:force:pipe-P-120:axial:end-j.
Clicking the axial end-j force row opens a detail panel showing end_j and the j-end sign convention.
Results include result:stress:pipe-P-120 and result:stress:pipe-P-120:end-j:torsional-shear.

Clicking the end-j torsional-shear stress row opens result-detail-panel showing torsional_shear_stress, element_local, end_j, recovered_from_open_mechanics_stress_components, pipe:P-120, and the paired result:stress:pipe-P-120:end-i:torsional-shear.
The model context selects pipe:P-120 and the property inspector (aria-label="Property inspector") shows "Rack span".

Results include quarter-station and shear rows: result:force:pipe-P-120:shear-y, result:force:pipe-P-120:shear-y:end-j, result:force:pipe-P-120:quarter-1:shear-y, result:force:pipe-P-120:midspan:shear-z, result:force:pipe-P-120:quarter-3:shear-z, and result:moment:pipe-P-120:quarter-1:bending-z.
Clicking the midspan axial force row shows midspan, interpolated_from_endpoint_resultants, and no endpoint-pair table.
Clicking the quarter-1 shear-y force row shows shear_force_y, quarter_1, interpolated_from_endpoint_resultants, and no endpoint-pair table.
Clicking the shear-y force row confirms endpoint-pair display still applies to endpoint shear force rows and includes result:force:pipe-P-120:shear-y:end-j.

Results include result:combination:combination-C-OPER-ALT:force:pipe-P-120:axial; its detail panel shows explicit_user_linear_combination, combination:combination:C-OPER-ALT, source result refs for result:force:pipe-P-120:axial and result:loadcase:load-L-200:force:pipe-P-120:axial, and no compliance or professional approval claim.
Results include result:combination:combination-C-OPER-ALT:force:pipe-P-120:quarter-1:shear-y and result:stress:pipe-P-120:quarter-1:torsional-shear.
The mechanics-gap-ledger includes gap:endpoint-j-recovery with status implemented; this is not a compliance failure.
The mechanics-gap-ledger includes gap:endpoint-stress-components with status implemented; this is not a compliance failure.

The mechanics-gap-ledger includes gap:station-recovery with status implemented: fixed station-grid recovery implemented, with arbitrary station sweeps, exact internal diagrams, and shear stress recovery deferred.
The mechanics-gap-ledger includes gap:thermal-behavior with status implemented, with broader thermal combinations and temperature-dependent properties deferred.
The mechanics-gap-ledger includes gap:load-combinations with status implemented, with code/rule combinations still deferred.
The mechanics-gap-ledger includes gap:pressure-frame-load with status implemented, with broader pressure behavior still deferred.

Results include result:stress:pipe-P-120:end-i:pressure-hoop, exclude pressure-longitudinal and shear stress rows such as result:stress:pipe-P-120:quarter-1:shear-y, and diagnostics do not include PRESSURE_LOAD_NOT_APPLIED_TO_FRAME_VECTOR.
Diagnostics render diagnostics-panel and include diagnostic-HIGH_DISPLACEMENT_REVIEW and diagnostic-RULE_CHECK_INPUTS_MISSING.

Clicking diagnostic-HIGH_DISPLACEMENT_REVIEW shows diagnostic-detail-panel with diagnostic:physics:high-displacement-review, result:disp:node-N-140, node:N-140, linked result value context, and the review-only professional boundary.
The model context selects node:N-140 and the property inspector (aria-label="Property inspector") shows "Terminal tie-in".
Knowledge renders knowledge-panel and includes computed context for result:disp:node-N-140 and result:force:pipe-P-120:axial.

Report packet renders report-panel and report-packet-body with selected result refs including displacement, force, midspan, quarter, combination, and torsional-shear stress results for node-N-140 and pipe-P-120.
Report packet includes report-analysis-run with DEL-14-02 and run:preview-linear-static-001; report-packet-body includes the result-value hash and result_envelope audit context.
Report packet includes report-load-basis-refs with load:L-100, load:L-200, and combination:C-OPER-ALT.
Clicking generate-review-proposal generates a review proposal.
The proposal renders proposal-body and references the selected review target result:stress:pipe-P-120:end-j:torsional-shear if the endpoint stress row remains selected.
After selecting diagnostic-HIGH_DISPLACEMENT_REVIEW, generating a proposal references diagnostic:physics:high-displacement-review and uses diagnostic review wording.
accept-proposal-disabled is disabled; the proposal must remain review-only and must not mutate accepted model state.
Footer retains the technical-preview boundary text and does not claim production readiness, release readiness, certification, sealing, code compliance, or licensed engineering reliance.
